These fey-blooded, 9-foot-tall, bearded, red-haired giants are crafty and violently territorial. They dwell in cold, rugged woodlands and deep mountain vales.

AC 8, HP 49, ATK 3 fist +9 (2d10) or 1 boulder (far) +9 (2d10), MV double near, S +6, D -2, C +4, I -3, W -3, Ch -4, AL C, LV 10

These ferocious, 10-foot-long wolves have long, blood-matted fur, glowing yellow eyes, and a fanged maw that leaks sulfurous fumes.

This tangled ball of squirming, vaguely translucent white eels swims through the air, teeth gnashing and eyes ablaze.

AC 11, HP 15, ATK 1 bite (near) +7 (1d8 + paralyze), MV near, S +5, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -3, AL C, LV 2

Tiny creatures resembling glistening mauve brains with 4 clawed feet. Unable to experience emotions or indulge in the sins or physical pleasure on their own, they steal bodies to slake their unnatural appetites for gluttony, lust, and cruelty.

The intellect devourer gains access to the host body's languages, knowledge, and memories, but not spellcasting or supernatural abilities. The body decays and is uninhabitable after 3d6 days.

A menacing, man-eating spirit with the body of a jackal.

AC 13, HP 20, ATK 2 bites +4 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 4

Intelligent and cruel, this horse-sized quadruped has the head of a badger, hooves of a stag, and a mouth with sharp bony ridges instead of teeth.

AC 13, HP 23, ATK 2 bites +4 (1d8 + disintegration), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +1, I +1, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 5

Dimensional Charge. In place of attacks, teleport anywhere within sight and make 1 bite attack.

Disintegration. A creature reduced to 0 hit points from bite attack is turned to ash.

Slime Lord.description:
This shambling humanoid is covered head to foot with dripping green slime.

AC 8, HP 15, ATK 1 touch +2 (green slime), MV near, S +0, D -2, C +2, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 3

Green Slime. Green slime attaches to target (see green slime monster).

Impervious. Only damaged by cold or fire.

Slime Spatter. When slime lord is struck with a melee weapon, the weapon becomes coated with green slime. Additionally, all living creatures within close must succeed at a DC 10 DEX save to avoid being struck by a glob of green slime.

This 5-foot-diameter, translucent green sphere floats forward, dripping foul-smelling acidic droplets.

AC 11, HP 20, ATK 1 touch +4 (1d6 + latch + suffocation), MV near (fly), S +2, D +1, C +2, I -3, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 4

Impervious. Only damaged by cold or fire.

Latch. Attaches around target's head; touch attack auto-hits next round. DC 13 STR on turn to tear off.

Suffocation. If not removed in 2d4 rounds, target suffocates.

Slime, Cadaver.description:
This pinkish ooze is typically found lurking inside the body cavity of corpses.

AC 11, HP 20, ATK 1 tendril +4 (1d6 + burrow), MV near (climb), S +2, D +1, C +2, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 4

Burrow. DC 12 STR or DEX or slime forces its way into a target’s open orifice and begins to eat the target from the inside out. Target takes 2d10 damage per round until slime removed. Any spell or magical effect that heals HP drives out the slime. The slime is also driven out if the target takes 10 or more points of fire damage.

Slime. Half damage from nonmagical sources. Items made of wood, leather, or metal that touch the slime are destroyed on a d6 roll of 1-2.

This dripping, flesh-eating slime clings to dungeon walls and ceilings.

AC 8, HP 12, ATK 1 touch +2 (1d6 + acid + consume flesh), MV close, S +0, D -2, C +3, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2

Acid. When in contact with a victim, sticks on and exudes acid. The acid destroys wood or metal (including armor) in 4 rounds, but cannot affect stone.

Consume Flesh. Once stuck on a victim, can only be removed by fire (½ damage to victim and ½ damage to slime). Once in contact with flesh for 4 rounds, victim turns into green slime in a further 1d4 rounds.

Dripping with sticky white ichor, these 3-foot-long gray slugs have large moth-like wings that sound like wet sheets flapping in the wind.

AC 12, HP 10, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6 + slime), MV near (fly), S +1, D +2, C +1, I -4, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2

Slime. DC 11 CON or target paralyzed 1d4 rounds. While paralyzed, target takes 1d6 damage at the start of their turn.

Sloorgrek.description:
An enormous, cigar-shaped monstrosity radiating scores of sucker-lined tentacles, and a great eyeless head dominated by a gaping toothless maw.

AC 10, HP 30, ATK 4 tentacles +5 (1d6 + swallow and spew) or 1 acid spit (far) +5 (1d6), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +3, I -3, W -2, Ch -3, AL N, LV 6

Acid Spit. Target takes an additional 1d6 damage per round for 1d4 rounds.

Swallow and Spew. On a natural attack roll of 19-20, target is swallowed, coated with acid, and immediately regurgitated. Target lands next to Sloorgrek and takes 1d6 damage per round for 1d4 rounds.

The empty eye sockets of this blackened corpse suddenly emit a dull crimson glow as it lurches forward with great iron-nailed claws.

AC 8, HP 42, ATK 2 claw +7 (1d12) and 1 bite +7 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D -2, C +2, I -2, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 9

Impervious. Only harmed by magical sources. Immune to attacks from quarry.

Quarry. Humanoid target within double near and visible to slow walker becomes its quarry. Effect only ends if slow walker or quarry destroyed. Slow walker always knows quarry’s location (even if invisible or separated over any distance). ADV on attacks vs quarry. Only 1 quarry at a time.

Undead. Immune to morale checks.

Slug Folk.description:
A decadent and indolent race of drug-addicted, slug-like humanoid sorcerers.

AC 9, HP 27, ATK 2 dagger +4 (1d4) or 1 spell +5, MV near (climb), S +0, D -1, C +0, I +3, W +1, Ch +3, AL C, LV 6

Acid Spray (INT Spell). DC 13. 3d6 damage to all within a near-sized cube within far.

Cancel (INT Spell). DC 13. End 1 spell affecting a target within near.

Charm (INT Spell). DC 12. One living target. Contested CHA check or under slug folk’s control for 1d6 days.

Illusion (INT Spell). DC 12. Focus. Creates a convincing visible and audible illusion that fills up to a near-sized cube within far. DC 13 WIS to disbelieve.

Levitate (INT Spell). DC 12. Close. Focus. Hover near for duration, vertical movement only.

Snirik.description:
These horse-sized armored arthropods lurk beneath desert sands, hoping to impale unsuspecting prey on one of the many barbed spines along its back.

AC 16 (natural armor), HP 21, ATK 2 spines +4 (1d12), MV near (burrow), S +3, D +0, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 4

Impaling Spines. On a natural attack roll of 19-20, target takes x2 damage and is immobilized. DC 14 STR on turn to break free. Target takes 1d12 additional damage when removed from spine.
Snirik.name: Snirik

Specter.description:
A hateful, disembodied apparition, driven by a murderous jealousy of all living things.

AC 14, HP 22, ATK 1 death touch +4 (1d6 + life drain) or 1 possess, MV near (fly), S -4, D +4, C +0, I +0, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 5

Greater Undead. Immune to morale checks. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Life Drain. 1d4 CON damage. Death at 0 CON.

Possess. One target, close range. Contested CHA check. If specter wins, it inhabits target’s body and controls it for 1d4 rounds. Target takes 1d4 damage each round while possessed as body withers.

Spirit Doll.description:
Often taking the form of a doll, mannequin, or stuffed animal, these wicked constructs were granted unholy life by being infused with the soul of a murdered child.

AC 14, HP 16, ATK 1 claw +3 (1d4 + paralyze), MV near, S +0, D +4, C +4, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL C, LV 3

Impervious. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Paralyze. DC 12 CON or paralyzed for 1d4 rounds.

Phylactery. Cannot be killed while spirit vessel (a bloodstone embedded within the doll) is intact.

A 6-foot-long lizard with a snake-like body and a fanged, vaguely feline face.

AC 14, HP 19, ATK 2 bites +4 (1d8 + poison), MV near (climb), S +3, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 4

These corrupted treants stalk dark forests on the fringes of civilization.

AC 14, HP 38, ATK 3 vines +8 (1d10 + grab) or 1 rock (far) +8 (2d12), MV near, S +4, D -1, C +2, I +2, W +3, Ch -1, AL C, LV 8

Grab. DC 15 STR or target held. DC 15 STR on turn to break free. While target held, 1 vine attack auto hits.

Strangle. A grabbed target cannot speak and takes 2d6 damage per round.

Covered with beautiful multi-colored blooms, these predatory plants seek to capture and squeeze the life out of living prey.

AC 10, HP 14, ATK 1 lashing vine +3 (1d6 + grab), MV close, S +3, D +0, C +1, I -4, W +2, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3

Grab. DC 12 STR or target held. DC 12 STR on turn to break free.

This intelligent, six-limbed feline predator has oversized green eyes that contain captivating, endlessly spiraling patterns.

AC 14, HP 13, ATK 2 rend +4 (1d6) or 1 hypnotic gaze, MV double near (climb), S +1, D +4, C +0, I +1, W +3, Ch +2, AL C, LV 3

Hypnotic Gaze. All enemies within double near that can see the stygian lynx's eyes must make a DC 12 WIS check or be paralyzed for 1d4 rounds.

Impervious. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

An emaciated half-monkey, half-opossum with a grinning mouth full of jagged teeth and a clutch of cruel-eyed whelps in the skin-fold on its belly.

AC 13, HP 24, ATK 2 claws +4 (1d6) and 1 bite +0 (1d6) or 1 mind thrust, MV near (climb), S +0, D +3, C +2, I +2, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 5

Mind Thrust. Fills a near-sized cube extending from the su-monster. DC 12 INT or 2d6 damage and paralyzed for 1d4 rounds.

Stealthy. ADV on DEX checks to sneak and hide.

Telepathy. Though su-monsters can't speak, they can read surface thoughts and communicate simple ideas and phrases telepathically to a range of far.

Takwin.description:
Made of mud, bones, and living tissue, the tiny humanoid constructs serve their masters with submissive devotion.

AC 12, HP 9, ATK 1 bite +3 (1 + poison), MV near, S -3, D +2, C +0, I -1, W +1, Ch -1, AL N, LV 2

Poison. DC 11 CON or target stupefied 1d4 rounds.

Regeneration. Heals 1d6 HP at the start of its turn. Only dies if it starts its turn with 0 HP. If within near range, its creator also gains this regeneration.
Takwin.name: Takwin

Tassargoi.description:
These furry, five-limbed, goblin-sized predators hunt for prey in the canopies of thick forests and jungles.

AC 13, HP 24, ATK 2 claw +5 (1d8) or 1 electric shock, MV near (climb), S +1, D +3, C +2, I -1, W +2, Ch -3, AL C, LV 5

Drink Brain. Inserts a proboscis into the head of a helpless creature and drinks its brain. Tassargoi heals 1d6 HP and target takes 1d4 INT damage. Die at 0 INT.

Electric Shock. Once per hour, can emit a blast of electricity that fills a near-sized cube extending from the tassargoi. Those in the cube take 3d6 damage and must succeed at a DC 13 CON check or be paralyzed 1d4 rounds.

The Pinestraw Man.description:
The legendary Pinestraw Man has haunted the rugged wilderness of the Shadowwood for centuries. A boogey-man to the simple who live in the great forest’s shadow, he resembles a 10-foot-tall humanoid wearing a tattered cloak, wielding a notched and bloody woodsman's axe. His face is featureless, except for a gaping mouth full of large rotten teeth. Instead of blood, the Pinestraw Man's body is full of pine needles, which spill forth from any open wounds.

AC 12, HP 66, ATK 3 woodsmans axe +9 (1d10 + amputate), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +3, I +1, W +3, Ch -2, AL C, LV 14

Amputate. On a natural attack roll of 18-19, target loses a randomly determined limb. On a natural attack roll of 20, target is beheaded.

Flammable. Takes double damage from fire.

Legendary. Only damaged by fire and magical sources. Immune to bludgeoning and piercing attacks. Hostile spells targeting the Pinestraw Man are DC 16 to cast.

Regeneration. Heals 10 HP at the beginning of his turn. Only dies if he starts his turn with 0 HP.

Vanishing Strike. In place of attacking, the Pinestraw Man makes a single melee attack with his axe and then teleports to anywhere within far range.

This fanatical cult of malevolent walking skeletons have ritualistically stripped their own flesh from their bodies.

A massive humanoid with tusks and three dim-witted, often bickering, heads.

AC 9, HP 34, ATK 3 greatclub +7 (2d6), MV near, S +4, D -1, C +3, I -2, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 7

Three Heads. Can't be surprised. ADV on saves vs charm and mind-affecting spells.

Tommyknocker.description:
These 2-foot-tall wiry humanoids have large heads, wrinkled faces, sunken eyes, and long white whiskers. They are xenophobic and unpredictable, but sometimes warn miners of impending cave collapses.

AC 13, HP 5, ATK 1 mining pick +2 (1d6), MV near, S -1, D +3, C +1, I +0, W +2, Ch -1, AL N, LV 1

Meld. Step inside solid stone.

Stealthy. ADV on DEX checks to sneak and hide.

Stealthy.name: Stealthy

This 4-foot-long nearly transparent eel-thing has dozens of barbed appendages and a circular maw with many rows of tiny razor sharp teeth.

AC 12, HP 20, ATK 1 bite +4 (1d8 + tongue-eater infection), MV near (swim), S +1, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 4

This enormous, bloated sack of transparent, gelatinous flesh is covered with barbed appendages. Its great circular maw is ringed by multiple rows of jagged, dagger-sized teeth.

Brood mother regurgitates all swallowed if dealt at least 15 damage in 1 round to the inside of its gullet or once a swallowed creature is infected.
